subtitles.en: So with these profits that you've banked and given that backdrop, what are your plans and also, of course, the high fuel costs, I know you've had some renewables as far as changing out some of the less efficient ships, what's your fleet expansion plans right now?
subtitles.zh: 在盈利和当前背景下，你们的计划是什么？高燃油成本下，更换低效船舶，船队扩张计划如何？

subtitles.en: So today we have a pipeline of 25 ships, and ten of those are new buildings which will be delivered to 28 and 29, six of them in China and four in Japan, and top of that, the remaining 15 ships are optional ships that we either have option at the shipyards or we have options for buying ships that we have taken on charter.
subtitles.zh: 目前我们有25艘船的储备，其中10艘是新造船，将在2028-29年交付，6艘在中国，4艘在日本。其余15艘是期权船，我们可以在船厂或租约中行使选择权。

subtitles.en: We like the optionality, especially in a market today where the volatility, and there's a cyclical business as well, so we feel we are very well positioned, 25 ships in the pipeline but only committed to ten of them the rest of the options.
subtitles.zh: 我们喜欢这种灵活性，尤其是在波动和周期性的市场中。我们定位很好，25艘船中只承诺10艘，其余是期权。

title_lines: 船队更新需求能否支撑？

subtitles.en: Talk to us about the, you know, when you talk about this balance, the freight market looks quite tight, new bills are also quite pricey, how are you looking at things going forward in terms of freight, fleet renewal, I should say.
subtitles.zh: 谈谈这种平衡，运费市场紧张，新船价格高，你们如何看待未来的运费和船队更新？

subtitles.en: The view we have already is that asset values are high, so it's actually very expensive, at least historically it's expensive to buy the ship, so in that sense we are a little bit careful and that's why we like the optionality instead of the full commitment to it, the yards are full, if you want to buy a ship today, you probably get delivered in 2030,
subtitles.zh: 我们认为资产价值高，买船很贵，所以比较谨慎，喜欢期权而非全承诺。船厂排满，现在买船可能2030年交付。

subtitles.en: looking at the profile of the fleet today, there's an order book in our segment, around 12% of the fleet is on order, but ships above 20 years is above about 14%, that's quite balanced actually,
subtitles.zh: 看当前船队结构，我们板块的订单占船队约12%，而20年以上船龄占14%，相当平衡。

subtitles.en: and there is actually the last hike we had in the market in 2009 to 12th, one third of the fleet is built at that time, in 2029 they will become 20 years old, when ships become 20 years older become a little bit more difficult to trade their small fuel inefficient and so on.
subtitles.zh: 2009-2012年市场高峰时建造的船占三分之一，到2029年将满20年，老旧船交易困难且燃油效率低。

subtitles.en: So actually when you look at the balance of things even though asset values are high, it looks quite balanced actually going forward.
subtitles.zh: 所以尽管资产价值高，但供需平衡，未来看起来相当均衡。

subtitles.en: Yeah. I think the sentiment is certainly shifting a little bit.
subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为市场情绪确实在发生一些变化。

subtitles.en: In May early June, what we saw is extreme concentration in terms of investors' focus, in terms of the sector positioning.
subtitles.zh: 五月初到六月初，我们看到投资者关注度和板块配置都极度集中。

subtitles.en: And that's when we saw the press of the Hong Kong market was nearly a 10-year low. Only 10% of the Hong Kong stocks were trading above the 200-day average.
subtitles.zh: 当时香港市场的估值压力接近十年低位，只有10%的个股在200日均线之上。

subtitles.en: And that's usually sign of market botany. Since then, in July, we see some improvement in terms of the market press.
subtitles.zh: 这通常是市场见底的信号。自那以后，7月份市场压力有所缓解。

subtitles.en: I think, you know, currently, a lot of investor view is that the AI rally is not over. AI is structural. And there is real earnings contribution.
subtitles.zh: 目前很多投资者认为AI行情尚未结束，AI是结构性趋势，且有真实的盈利贡献。

subtitles.en: Nonetheless, you know, the extreme concentration in the upstream, in the semi-stocks, in the memory stocks is probably broadening out. And people look at cloud, for example, as one area where we see good revenue growth.
subtitles.zh: 不过，上游、半导体和存储板块的极度集中可能正在扩散。比如云服务领域，我们看到不错的收入增长。

subtitles.en: And this monetization is a big concern for Chinese internet platforms, in particular, is that can you monetize on the two C and, you know, the more success you become in your LLM, the more costly it will become for your earnings, right? That's the concern.
subtitles.zh: 对于中国互联网平台来说，变现能力是个大问题——大模型越成功，对盈利的成本压力就越大，这正是市场的担忧。

clips.speaker_context: Head of APEC Equity Strategy at BFA Global Research

clips.speaker: Winnie Wu
clips.title: AI资本开支烧钱：巨头融资压力隐现，钱从哪来？

subtitles.en: So I think for second half, for now, second half, there are a couple things at play. Global, like, what is this whole AI CapEx story, right?
subtitles.zh: 对于下半年，有几个关键因素在起作用。全球来看，AI资本开支的故事如何演绎？

subtitles.en: We're looking, we're following the US big-tax companies, CapEx guidance, people looking at their free cash flow situation to see the sustainability of that. People looking for new monetization opportunities, right?
subtitles.zh: 我们关注美国大型科技公司的资本开支指引，以及它们的自由现金流状况，以判断可持续性。同时市场也在寻找新的变现机会。

subtitles.en: Is there suddenly going to be some killer app or edge devices or physical AI that will drive another wave of this demand for upstream capacity? But on the other side, people also watching the Fed decision. What does that mean?
subtitles.zh: 是否会出现杀手级应用、边缘设备或物理AI，从而带动新一轮上游需求？另一方面，市场也在关注美联储的决策。

subtitles.en: Most of capital, right, things, you know, the capital raising for these CapEx is becoming more and more important. But back to China now, I think, you know, earning season is important, right?
subtitles.zh: 资本开支的融资变得越来越重要。回到中国市场，盈利季很关键。

subtitles.en: That's why some of the e-commerce platforms has been doing well recently, because people expecting to reduce the subsidy to quick commerce, hopefully will drive better earnings, whereas some of the other large platforms more in the media advertisement sector are still struggling a little bit, right?
subtitles.zh: 近期一些电商平台表现较好，因为市场预期补贴减少将改善盈利，而一些以广告为主的平台仍面临压力。

subtitles.en: So, you know, earning season, the dynamic is very important. But also coming back to fundamental economy, people are watching China's export, you know, consumption data.
subtitles.zh: 盈利季的动态非常重要。回到基本面，市场也在关注中国的出口和消费数据。

subtitles.en: First of all, we had kind of sort of k-shaped economy, very strong external demand, weakening of domestic CapEx and consumption. Is there any rebalancing of that or, as of now, we seem to continue the deterioration in domestic demand?
subtitles.zh: 我们看到了K型经济：外需强劲，但国内资本开支和消费偏弱。这种状况是否会再平衡？目前国内需求似乎仍在承压。

clips.speaker: Winnie Wu
clips.title: 政府收入占比骤降：税收征管加严，企业盈利承压？

subtitles.en: The big picture background is that China's overall government revenue to GDP, including the tax, including, like, land sales revenue, was 31 percent in 2019.
subtitles.zh: 大背景是，2019年中国政府总收入占GDP的比重，包括税收和土地出让收入，为31%。

subtitles.en: By last year, it was down to only 24 percent, right? That's a combination of land sales revenue nearly half, but also government did a lot of tax breaks, exemptions during the COVID season.
subtitles.zh: 到去年，这一比例降至24%。原因是土地出让收入近乎减半，同时疫情期间政府实施了大量减税和免税政策。

subtitles.en: And now, with this low level, government probably need to rebuild some of the tax capability. But also is that with China's golden tax phase four, with the CRS, the common reporting standard exchange of tax information across countries, it makes the stronger enforcement become possible.
subtitles.zh: 在收入水平较低的情况下，政府可能需要重建税收能力。同时，金税四期和CRS（共同申报准则）使得税收征管更加严格成为可能。

subtitles.en: So, what we saw since last year, there was the VAT on gold in November last year, there was the VAT increase on telcos in January, there's talks about social security, contribution enforcement in July, which be to the concern like consumers, restaurants, property management, logistic delivery companies, and over the past months, we heard that the tax on individuals of short income, whether it's insurance or trust.
subtitles.zh: 自去年以来，我们看到去年11月对黄金征收增值税，1月电信行业增值税上调，7月社保征缴强化，这引发了市场对消费、餐饮、物业、物流等行业的担忧。近几个月，还听说对个人短期收入（如保险或信托）征税。

subtitles.en: And they're trying to spread demand. Well, you know, it's a long-term versus short-term thing. With the aging population, you need to build up the safety network from social security.
subtitles.zh: 他们试图分散需求。这是长期与短期的权衡。随着人口老龄化，需要建立社会保障安全网。

subtitles.en: Not to mention also, I guess, when it comes to earnings for companies, the export facing ones. The run in B strength as well. How much of a headwind is that?
subtitles.zh: 此外，对于出口型企业，本币走强也是一个逆风因素。这会造成多大影响？

clips.speaker: Tan Su Shan
clips.title: 星展CEO谈AI成本：中国模型便宜80%，开放架构如何选？

subtitles.en: The irony, and I call it the paradox of token spend, is the more tokens you consume, the lower the cost.
subtitles.zh: 讽刺的是，我称之为令牌消耗悖论：消耗越多，成本反而越低。

subtitles.en: And we're seeing that tip now, and we're expecting our token consumption, and we're starting to lower our cost because of the cash, the memory, the optimization, the use of SLMs, etc.
subtitles.zh: 我们现在正看到这一拐点，预计令牌消耗将增加，但成本开始下降，得益于缓存、内存、优化以及小型语言模型的使用等。

subtitles.en: Our people are getting a lot smarter on how to optimize. So, that's good.
subtitles.zh: 我们的员工在优化方面越来越聪明，这是好事。

subtitles.en: And when it comes to models, I guess the big debate is Western models versus the Chinese models, which are 80% cheaper, some say, how do you take that into consideration?
subtitles.zh: 关于模型，最大的争论是西方模型与中国模型，据说中国模型便宜80%，你们如何考虑这一点？

subtitles.en: We've always been open around not being too weathered to anyone. I think we have, we have an open architecture.
subtitles.zh: 我们一直保持开放，不过度依赖任何一家。我们拥有开放架构。

subtitles.en: That means we're not overly reliant on anyone provider, whether it's an SLM or LLM or an AI harness builder, whatever.
subtitles.zh: 这意味着我们不过度依赖任何供应商，无论是小型语言模型、大型语言模型还是AI工具构建者。

subtitles.en: The key is to see who's good at what. To prove soft concepts, we do POCs with everyone, really, and we figure out who's good.
subtitles.zh: 关键看谁擅长什么。为了验证概念，我们与各方进行概念验证，找出谁更优秀。

subtitles.en: And then you then figure out for yourself what is sovereign to you? What do you want code to you want to own yourself? What sovereign code? What sovereign model? What sovereign AI?
subtitles.zh: 然后你自己确定什么是你的主权？你想拥有哪些代码？主权代码、主权模型、主权AI是什么？

subtitles.en: What sovereign AI harness do you want for yourself? And what do you want to use as third parties? So all this work is being done right now.
subtitles.zh: 你想要什么样的主权AI工具？哪些使用第三方？这些工作正在进行中。

clips.title: 星展CEO谈AI安全：护栏与控制平面，如何防范模型风险？

subtitles.en: There are institutions out there which have said no to Chinese models because of the risk involved. Does that keep you up at night?
subtitles.zh: 有些机构因风险而拒绝中国模型，这会让你夜不能寐吗？

subtitles.en: It's on whoever uses them to put the right guard rails out. And we've got all our guard rails.
subtitles.zh: 使用方有责任设置正确的护栏，我们已设置所有护栏。

subtitles.en: And as I said, we're creating an AI harness, an AI control plane so that we have the observability, accountability, and we have to patch.
subtitles.zh: 如我所说，我们正在创建AI工具和控制平面，以实现可观测性、问责制，并需要打补丁。

subtitles.en: It's upon us right now to do that and do the right thing by our customers. So we're all over this cybersecurity and the use of AI to counter AI, top of mind.
subtitles.zh: 我们现在有责任这样做，为客户做正确的事。我们高度重视网络安全和以AI对抗AI。

subtitles.en: The three to five years down the road, how do you see AI? I guess reshaping DBS. I think it will fundamentally change the way we work, right?
subtitles.zh: 未来三到五年，AI将如何重塑星展？我认为它将从根本上改变我们的工作方式。

subtitles.en: And it means that workflows and work processes that we're used to in a vertical way will become more horizontal.
subtitles.zh: 这意味着我们习惯的垂直工作流程将变得更加水平化。

subtitles.en: It means that there will be things that, you know, as an organization, you'll have to own that that's what I meant by sovereign code or owning your own code.
subtitles.zh: 这意味着作为组织，你必须拥有某些东西，这就是我所说的主权代码或拥有自己的代码。

subtitles.en: There'll be things that you can buy. It's faster and easier and that's fine. And things you own and you build.
subtitles.zh: 有些东西可以购买，更快更容易，没问题。有些东西你需要自己拥有和构建。

subtitles.en: But what is important? What is the mode? What are your modes to keep you ahead? Because tech in itself is not a differentiator.
subtitles.zh: 但重要的是什么？模式是什么？哪些模式让你保持领先？因为技术本身不是差异化因素。

subtitles.en: Your own differentiation is number one, your customer data. How well you use it? Number two, your culture, whether you have a culture of innovation, are you fast, are you nimble?
subtitles.zh: 你的差异化首先是客户数据，你如何用好它？其次是文化，是否有创新文化，是否快速敏捷？

subtitles.en: Number three, trust. That money can't buy. But your customer trust in you is sacrosanct. And how do you protect that?
subtitles.zh: 第三是信任，金钱买不到。客户对你的信任是神圣不可侵犯的，你如何保护它？

subtitles.en: So for us, it's all about making sure our data works end to end. You need to have ownership end to end from the moment the data is born to the day is expelled, expelled from the system.
subtitles.zh: 对我们来说，关键是确保数据端到端运作。从数据诞生到从系统删除，你需要端到端的所有权。

subtitles.en: Who owns it? How do you keep it safe? And how do you use it in a way that it's spainable and useful to your customer?
subtitles.zh: 谁拥有它？如何保证安全？如何以可持续且对客户有用的方式使用它？

subtitles.en: And then your culture of innovation, your people, people that are telling me, you know, the level one production engineering work is gone.
subtitles.zh: 然后是创新文化和人才，有人告诉我，一级生产工程工作已经消失。

subtitles.en: So I'm now learning domain knowledge, whether it's wealth tag, trading tag, alcohol trading, whatever it is.
subtitles.zh: 所以我现在学习领域知识，无论是财富标签、交易标签还是其他。

subtitles.en: They're learning that domain knowledge and they're upscaling to become a level two builder, level two production engineer.
subtitles.zh: 他们学习领域知识，并升级为二级构建者、二级生产工程师。

subtitles.en: That means you become a higher productivity, higher order work. And that's what we're hoping that the AI won't enable the human to take on higher order work.
subtitles.zh: 这意味着你成为更高生产力、更高阶的工作。我们希望AI能让人类承担更高阶的工作。

subtitles.en: There will come a time where customers might have their own agents interact with your agents, right?
subtitles.zh: 未来客户可能会有自己的智能体与你的智能体互动。

subtitles.en: But if you're lucky and your agents are good and trusted customers might use your agent, right?
subtitles.zh: 如果幸运，你的智能体优秀且受信任，客户可能会使用你的智能体。

subtitles.en: So and then it's how you create your agent control plane, how you create your agent harness to be safe, to be relevant, and to have end-to-end accountability, to be grounded in governance and
subtitles.zh: 然后是如何创建智能体控制平面和工具，确保安全、相关、端到端问责，并以治理为基础。

subtitles.en: and to be grounded in governance and ...
subtitles.zh: 并以治理为基础……

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
